facts.text: The arena offers wheelchair seating at all price levels and up to three companion tickets when available. Some sections may be unavailable because of production requirements. Request accessible seating when buying tickets; call the box office at 859-292-2889 for event-specific arrangements.

Truist Arena meets or exceeds all structural and service requirements as stipulated by the Americans with Disabilities Act. Restrooms, drinking fountains, Truist Arena ATMs, and counters are accessible to guests with disabilities. Wheelchair accessible seats are available in all price levels. facts.text: Accessible parking is in Lot O and the Welcome Center Garage; spaces are limited and first come, first served.

facts.text: Amplification devices are available for most events with at least one week's notice and photo ID. Sign-language interpretation requests require three weeks' notice and production approval.

A photo ID is required when borrowing the device and all amplification devices are operable from any seat.

Requests for this service must be received three weeks prior to the event and be approved by production management. For details, please email us at info@thetruistarena.com or call the Truist Arena Office at (859) 442-2659.

facts.text: The September 2024 meeting policy asks for room or program applications at least 21 calendar days ahead, permits reservations up to one year ahead and schedules them first come, first served. Advance approval is required; an acknowledgement is not final confirmation, and an approved booking can be displaced for site work or safety.
facts.quote: Applications for the use of the meeting spaces or to schedule a program require advance LM permission and approval. To use a meeting space or to schedule a program, an application must be filled out and submitted. Applications can be obtained by emailing fernald@lm.doe.gov. A completed application must be submitted by an authorized representative of the requesting group; this person is responsible for sharing this policy with other members of the group as needed, supervising the group, and being present during the requested event. Applications will receive an email acknowledgement within 3 business days. After the request is reviewed and approved, a final confirmation will be emailed. Applications should be submitted at least 21 calendar days before the requested date. Reservations can be made up to 1 year in advance. Reservations are scheduled on a first-come, first-served basis. LM reserves the right to preempt an approved reservation to conduct business, maintenance, repair, or construction or as needed to ensure the safety of staff and visitors. Applications may be denied if the meeting space or staff is unavailable, the application is incomplete, or the proposed use is contrary to the general use terms and conditions stated above. If an application is denied, the applicant will be informed of the denial and the reason for the denial.

facts.text: The September 2024 policy lists the Community Meeting Room at 120 people in theater layout, 80 in classroom layout or 40 in conference layout. Alternative arrangements require prior application approval and staff supervision; return the room to its original layout afterward.

Users can reconfigure the room under the supervision of staff if alternate layouts are requested on the application and approved by LM. Before departure, the room must be returned to its original configuration under the supervision of staff.
